Pasta In White Sauce
By: Anita Mokashi
Published: Tuesday, October 16, 2012 - 6:09pm

Ingredients




2 cups of pasta
2 tbsp butter
3-4 garlic cloves chopped
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
1 cup milk
½ cup cream
½ cup goat cheese and parmesan cheese
1 tbsp chilli flakes
1 tbsp pepper powder
salt

Preparation

1 Cook pasta as per directions. 2 In a pan heat butter. 3 Add chopped garlic. 4 Add flour and mix properly. Don’t let the lumps form. 5 Now add cream and milk. 6 Mix everything well.  Transfer the mixture to blender. Make a fine paste. 7 Again transfer the mixture to the pan. Add chilli flakes, pepper and salt 8 Let it cook. The white sauce it ready. 9 In a pan, take white sauce. Add cheese and salt pepper as per taste. 10 Now add cooked pasta. Cook for 5 minutes. 11 Serve it hot.

About

Pasta In White sauce is a delicious Italian dish made from adding pasta to flour, garlic, milk and cheese sauce.
